demoPantry.title: My Pantry
demoPantry.introduction: Keep track of what you have, see what needs using soon, and turn your ingredients into dinner.
demoPantry.entryHelp: Three ingredients are ready to add. Edit any value or choose Add One More before saving. Dates are editable estimates.
demoPantry.invalid: Enter a name, a quantity greater than zero, and a valid date for each ingredient.
demoPantry.addError: We couldn't add your ingredients. Your entries are still here. Please try again.
demoPantry.resetConfirm: Restore the starting pantry and clear your demo points and cooking history? This also removes ingredients you added to this demo.
demoPantry.resetDone: Your demo is ready to start again.
demoPantry.resetError: We couldn't reset the demo. Please try again.
demoPantry.meals_one: {{count}} home-cooked meal. Keep up your cooking habit!
demoPantry.meals_other: {{count}} home-cooked meals. Keep up your cooking habit!
demoPantry.empty: Add ingredients to prepare your next home-cooked meal.
